openai.feedback:
- Category: bug  
  Severity: medium  
  File: server/src/core/mission-context/resolver-parts.ts:130  
  Finding: The “content-fingerprinted” supersession memo is not actually a content fingerprint: it uses only transcript length and the final 256 characters. Distinct bounded transcript snapshots can have the same length and suffix while containing a different later corroborated `Run-ID:` footer earlier in the tail. In that case `buildRecoveryThunk` replays a previously recovered run without re-scanning, so the Mission context can remain on the wrong run and fail the stale-association recovery behavior.  
  Suggestion: Use a collision-resistant fingerprint of the complete transcript snapshot (for example a hash), or include a reliable transcript revision/offset supplied by the reader. Do not reuse a recovery result based only on length plus a short suffix.

- Category: bug  
  Severity: medium  
  File: server/src/core/mission-context/association.ts:99  
  Finding: `supersedeMissionContext` overwrites whichever association is currently stored, without checking that it is still the stale association from which the resolver made its decision. A concurrent request can update the task association after resolution (for example, from a newer live pointer), and this delayed supersession can then overwrite that newer association with an older transcript-derived result.  
  Suggestion: Pass the expected previous association into `supersedeMissionContext` and compare its run ID and `observedAt` before patching. If it no longer matches, skip the write and let the next resolve operate on the current association.

- Category: test  
  Severity: low  
  File: client/src/components/external/mission/MissionActivityFeed.test.tsx:220  
  Finding: The timestamp UI tests validate relative-time text and absence, but do not validate the required full-date tooltip. Removing the `title={new Date(at).toLocaleString()}` behavior from `FeedTime` would still leave all newly added client timestamp tests passing.  
  Suggestion: Assert that a timestamped card’s `.mc-feed-time` element has a non-empty `title` representing the event timestamp, preferably with a deterministic locale/time-zone setup.

Overall assessment: ship-with-fixes. The four requested behaviors are substantially implemented and covered, but the supersession cache can return stale run identity for distinct transcript content, and the association update needs a compare-before-write guard to avoid clobbering concurrent updates.
